node.title: AQB shared box-charge amortization
node.statement: For the averaged c=2 quotient-box family, the shared box charge amortizes by at least 429,645,547 bits relative to the single-word floor at sigma*.
node.attack_surface: assembly from the family definition, proved threshold accounting, and the remaining shared-family entropy-gain inequality
node.falsifier: a certified upper bound showing that the proposed averaged family saves less than 429,645,547 bits after all multiplicities, overlaps, and quotient/fiber normalizations are charged
node.notes: AQB ROUTE REFUTED (Pro, verified): convex-combination obstruction — the averaging transfer needs the family AVERAGE (convex comb of single-box counts <= max box), so box-sharing saves log|F| but the ÷|F| normalization cancels it. Gain needs a heavy-fiber theorem (forbidden, circular). See aqb_coupled_family_entropy_manifest_payload/refutation.md.
